title: Los Acuerdos de Paz
goal: Read how the Sandinista elections, the 1992 Peace Accords and Guatemala's late peace each ended these wars through negotiation, not military victory -- and what those settlements left unresolved.
grammar: No sin antes: reconocer un paso previo necesario

items: Describe how the Sandinista government accepted free elections after years of war.
State when the Peace Accords were signed and who signed them.
Explain why Guatemala was the last country to reach peace.
Explain the shared pattern across all three peace processes.
Use no sin antes to acknowledge a necessary prior step.
